notes: Entry is internally contradictory: 'Before calculating indicators, aggregate the data into 30-minute candles' conflicts with 'ma_crosses ... (based on 5-minute data)', leaving avg_rsi computable as mean of six 5m RSI(14) values or as RSI(14) on 30m candles - different signals, different tapes; window-boundary cross counting and fill timing (next 5m bar vs next 30m bar) are also unpinned. Exit adds stop-loss 1.5% / take-profit 3.0% with mechanism unpinned (intra-bar stop/limit orders vs close checks, 5m vs 30m granularity, same-bar SL/TP precedence), so fill timestamps under the D3 (timestamp, side) key can diverge. Sizing is hedged ('fixed position size, for example, 100% of available capital') and all-in sizing with commission 0.001 yields order-rejection divergence. 'Tested on a set of 30-50 liquid tickers' vs the single bound AAPL 5m feed triggers multi-asset-required (requirements file flags requires_multi_asset: true); prose asset is generic S&P 500 so binding_coherent holds, and 5m->30m aggregation is cleanly implementable on the bound 4680-row 5m cache. Indicator periods (SMA 13/40, RSI 14, MACD 12/26/9) are all explicit; no hardcoded absolute price levels.
